title: UniPoolerV2 inherits F-01-047 verbatim: DonationSkipped / _dispatch NatSpec still lists 'dust', but the gemAmt == 0 branch is a silent no-op; the new contract-level NatSpec omits dust, so the contract contradicts itself
description: Because the code was copied verbatim, the documentation defect logged as F-01-047 on BalancerPoolerV2 was copied too. The DonationSkipped NatSpec says it fires on 'PSM outage / fee spike / dust', and the _dispatch NatSpec lists 'dust' among the failures that 'park the USDS'. In _psmDonate (line 353) a dust sweep (gemAmt == 0) is a clean no-op, so no revert reaches the catch and DonationSkipped is never emitted. UniPoolerV2's new contract-level NatSpec (lines 29-32) leaves dust off its list, so the contract now contradicts itself.
impact: None; documentation self-contradiction (DonationSkipped/_dispatch NatSpec name 'dust', gemAmt==0 branch is silent).
severityJustification: New-contract instance of F-01-047 (open); kept as its own entry because story-050 deletes BalancerPoolerV2 and F-01-047 would otherwise close as code-removed while the defect persists. Related monitoring gap stays with L-18.
recommendation: Drop 'dust' from the DonationSkipped and _dispatch NatSpec in UniPoolerV2. This is a comment-only change and does not breach the verbatim-code clause.
